title: Parameters are copies
prompt: Write `add_ten`, which takes a number, adds 10 to its parameter with +=, and prints it. In `solve`, call add_ten(n) and then print n yourself, so solve(5) prints 15 and then 5. The original does not change.
hints: A number passed to a function is copied; changing the copy inside leaves the caller's variable alone.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
